title: The Service and Covering of the Sanctuary by the Sons of Kohath
description: The Lord gives Moses and Aaron detailed instructions about the service of Kohath's sons in the tent of meeting. When the camp is to break up, Aaron and his sons are to cover the ark, the table for the bread of the Presence, the lampstand, the gold altar, and the bronze altar with cloths and hides before the Kohathites may carry them. They are warned not to touch or look at the holy things before they are covered, for then they will die. Eleazar is put in charge of the oil, the incense, and the articles of the sanctuary.
